items.headline: Chipotle stock falls on potential link to salmonella outbreak in Minnesota
items.summary: Chipotle has pulled the affected supply from restaurants and replaced them with peppers from different growers, according to the company.

items.headline: Sen. Susan Collins will oppose Blanche, a critical blow for Trump's AG pick

items.headline: New Jersey sues Amazon on antitrust grounds, alleging it unlawfully wielded its power over delivery contractors
items.summary: The complaint alleges Amazon's third-party delivery model leads to lower wages, unfair working conditions and a lack of competition.
